question.text: If the domain of the function $\sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{3 x-22}{2 x-19}\right)+\log _{\mathrm{e}}\left(\frac{3 x^2-8 x+5}{x^2-3 x-10}\right)$ is $(\alpha, \beta]$, then $3 \alpha+10 \beta$ is equal to:

solution.text:
$\begin{array}{ll}
-1 \leq \frac{3 x-22}{2 x-19} \leq 1 & \frac{3 x^2-8 x+5}{x^2-3 x-10}>0 \\
x \in\left(5, \frac{41}{5}\right] & \\
3 \alpha+10 \beta=97 &
\end{array}$
